verdict.rationale: Terraform's core workflow is bulk operations. A single plan/apply covers every defined resource across providers: it builds a resource graph and parallelizes creation and modification of non-dependent resources, and `-destroy` plans removal of all remote objects. Users also report adding infrastructure in bulk via for_each and dynamic blocks, and say declarative moves and imports are now simple and safe. missing for 10: first-party docs on for_each/count-style bulk instancing, a smooth path for bulk state refactoring (users describe merging hundreds or thousands of resources via state mv as a big job), and evidence that performance holds up at large scale (users report having to split stacks).
